team.name: Front Office Team
team.bio: The front office helps with scheduling, forms, directions, benefit information, and the administrative details that prepare patients for a visit.

team.name: Dental Hygiene Team
team.bio: The hygiene team supports preventive visits, periodontal monitoring, and practical guidance patients can use between appointments.

team.name: Dental Assisting Team
team.bio: The assisting team prepares treatment rooms, supports procedures, and helps patients understand what to expect during the clinical portion of a visit.
